What if you ate an apple every day?
Apples are one of the most popular fruits in America. Does it really keep the doctor away? The saying comes from an old Welsh rhyme from the eighteen hundreds.

But here's the twist. A study of thousands of adults found apple eaters didn't visit the doctor much less, but they did use fewer prescription medicines! Apples are packed with fiber, and the skin holds a lot of the good stuff. It doesn't prove apples are magic, but they're still a great snack.
